headline: Sources: At least 3 teams in mix for Jets goalie Connor Hellebuyck
take:
Per ESPN, at least three teams are in the mix for Winnipeg Jets goalie Connor Hellebuyck, and several clubs remain interested. The report adds there is no guarantee the Jets deal him before his suspension ends.

Winnipeg sits at 4-2-2 with 10 points through eight games, which is a decent start, but the underlying numbers are less flattering. The Jets have generated 46.6% of the expected goals (a measure of shot quality that credits each chance by how often it should score) so far this season, so they have been outchanced more often than not. At five-on-five it is 46%. Their actual scoring has also trailed their chances, at 0.9 goals below expected.

What has kept the record afloat is goaltending: the Jets' goalies have saved 3.3 goals more than an average netminder would have on the same shots so far this season. That makes the trade chatter a real question for the team. If Hellebuyck leaves, Winnipeg loses the strength that is currently covering for a team that is giving up the better chances. The sample is only eight games, but the early signal is that this team leans heavily on its goalie.
